audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read "Skill" (0 through 6) while the matching content win[0..5] all said "Brand" and win[6] said "Renata" — and packet.levelChart independently confirms Brand/Brand/Brand/Brand/Brand/Brand/Renata. The full-layer chart disagreed with the content layer and the real data on all seven rows.
audit.why: A reader sees a flat "Skill" bar chart while the page's own prose (whys[0..6]) explicitly states Brand wins levels 1-5-and-first-item and Renata pulls ahead late — the chart and the text told two different stories.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0..5].side to Brand and phases[6].side to Renata to match win[] and packet.levelChart; rewrote each phases[N].why to state the actual reason for that verdict since none of the previous why text specified a winner.

audit.why: Level 2 (W-Q punishes her low base damage), level 6 (Hostile Takeover is a slow wave she must land exposed), and late (Bailout/E shields negate burn) are the real spikes and are already named correctly in the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The needs-antiheal missingInteraction (Bailout (W) delaying/saving from death) never reached the page. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED), and breakdown.cooldowns had no real numbers (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT). report[8].t and report[9].t misgendered Renata as he/him.
audit.why: Bailout can refund a kill even after the target would have died to burn, so Grievous Wounds timing matters more than raw damage in extended trades — the page never said so.
audit.corrected: Folded the shield-absorbs-burst (Loyalty Program E) fact into dosFull[1].d, the anti-heal/Bailout fact into dontsFull[2].d, added real cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns, and fixed the pronouns.
